notes: Six releases built an engine that writes events, fires rules and walks strategies. None of it was visible. An audit of the client against the code found three gaps of exactly the same shape — a payload that existed, that was tested, and that had no surface — and this release closes them. It is the first of two the owner asked for; the second, the backtest results surface, is separate. It adds no engine capability whatsoever. No new producer, no new predicate, no new action verb, no change to the tick, the loop, the backtester or the deflation. Every number on all three panels comes from a read
